Front-End Web Development

← Back to Featured Work

Update and maintain the Jentezen Franklin Media Ministries website using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Ruby, while collaborating with two additional developers. Employ tools such as Visual Studio Code, Heroku, Cloudflare, Salesforce, Cyberduck, Git, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and S3 buckets to enhance website performance and functionality.

Maintain effective communication with team members and supervisors regarding the website’s direction, code implementation, and script applications, while conducting routine site audits.

User-interface designs are created in Figma prior to code implementation.

In October 2023, led the redesign and rebranding of the website, ensuring mobile and tablet responsiveness. Key updates included the introduction of rounded borders for a softer visual style, transitioning the system font to San Francisco Pro, and improving the overall user experience and journey.

Explore the JFMM website on the Web Archive (prior to August 2023) to see the site before the 2023 redesign. Explore the JFMM website on the Web Archive here.
